name: list_surveys
title: List surveys
description: List surveys in a Forma workspace using the v3 Surveys API contract.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID whose surveys should be listed.

limit.description: Maximum number of surveys to return. Defaults to 20.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous list_surveys response.

includeTotalCount.description: Whether to include the total matching survey count in the response metadata. Defaults to true.

in.description: Survey statuses to include, for example draft or inProgress. Archived surveys are excluded unless archived is listed: on its own it returns only archived surveys, alongside real statuses it widens the result to both.
Survey types to include, for example link.

sortBy.description: Sort field for pagination. Defaults to the v3 API default of updatedAt.

name: get_survey
title: Get survey
description: Get one Forma survey using the v3 Surveys API contract.

lang.description: Optional language codes or configured aliases used to filter translatable survey fields.

name: create_survey
title: Create survey
description: Create a Forma link survey using the v3 Surveys API contract.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID where the survey should be created.

type.description: Survey type. Only link surveys are supported.

status.description: Initial survey status. Defaults to draft.

defaultLanguage.description: Default language code or configured language alias. Defaults to en-US.

metadata.description: Survey metadata using the v3 survey document contract.

languages.description: Configured survey languages using the v3 survey document contract.

code.description: Language code or configured language alias.

default.description: Whether this language is the default language.

welcomeCard.description: Welcome card using the v3 survey document contract.

blocks.description: Survey blocks using the v3 survey document contract.

endings.description: Survey endings using the v3 survey document contract.

hiddenFields.description: Hidden fields using the v3 survey document contract.

variables.description: Survey variables using the v3 survey document contract.

name: validate_survey
title: Validate survey
description: Validate a v3 survey create or patch payload without writing survey changes.

surveyId.description: Survey ID to validate against. Required for patch validation.

data.description: Create or patch payload to validate using the v3 survey document contract.

name: patch_survey
title: Patch survey
description: Update a Forma survey using the v3 Surveys API patch contract. Provided top-level arrays and objects replace that whole subtree.

data.description: Strict top-level v3 survey patch payload. Omitted top-level fields are preserved; provided objects and arrays replace that whole subtree.

name: delete_survey
title: Delete survey
description: Permanently delete a Forma survey and its responses using the v3 Surveys API contract. This cannot be undone — use archive_survey for the reversible soft delete the product offers beside it.

name: archive_survey
title: Archive survey
description: Archive a Forma survey using the v3 Surveys API contract. Archiving is reversible with restore_survey and excludes the survey from default reads.

name: restore_survey
title: Restore survey
description: Restore an archived Forma survey using the v3 Surveys API contract. Archived surveys are returned by list_surveys only when the status filter includes archived.

surveyId.description: Survey ID to restore from the archive.

name: list_workflows
title: List workflows
description: List workflows in a Forma workspace using the v3 Workflows API contract.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID whose workflows should be listed.

limit.description: Maximum number of workflows to return. Defaults to 20.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous list_workflows response.

in.description: Workflow statuses to include. Omitting returns every status except archived.

items.description: Lifecycle state of a workflow. Archived workflows are soft-deleted and excluded from default reads.

sortBy.description: Sort field for pagination. Defaults to the v3 API default of updatedAt.

name: get_workflow
title: Get workflow
description: Get one Forma workflow using the v3 Workflows API contract.

name: list_workflow_runs
title: List workflow runs
description: List workflow runs for a Forma workspace (newest first) using the v3 Workflows API contract.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID whose workflow runs should be listed.

limit.description: Maximum number of runs to return. Defaults to 20.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous list_workflow_runs response.

workflowId.description: Return only runs of this workflow.

responseId.description: Return only runs triggered by this survey response.

in.description: Run statuses to include, for example queued or completed.

isDryRun.description: Filter by dry-run vs real runs. Omit to return both.

filter.description: Optional supported v3 workflow run filters.

name: get_workflow_run
title: Get workflow run
description: Get one Forma workflow run with its ordered step logs using the v3 Workflows API contract.

runId.description: Workflow run ID to fetch, including its ordered step logs.

name: test_workflow
title: Test workflow (dry-run)
description: Dry-run a Forma workflow using the v3 Workflows API contract: validate its live definition would execute, resolve the trigger's survey + ending cards, and confirm every literal send_email recipient is an organization member. No run is persisted and no side effects occur; the response reports { ok, problems }.

workflowId.description: Workflow ID to dry-run (validate + mock execute, no side effects).

name: create_workflow
title: Create workflow
description: Create a Forma workflow (always as a draft) using the v3 Workflows API contract.

status.description: Workflows are always created as drafts; only enable can make them live.

schemaVersion.description: Workflow definition schema version understood by this package.

ui.description: Builder-only UI metadata that does not affect workflow execution.

endingCardIds.description: Ending card ids that should trigger the workflow. Empty means all endings.

trigger.description: Null while the draft has no trigger yet; the user adds one from the canvas.

ui.description: Builder-only UI metadata that does not affect workflow execution.

to.description: Recipient: either a literal email address, which must belong to someone who can access this workspace, or the element id of a survey question / hidden field holding the respondent's email (contact-info elements resolve index [2]). Enabling or testing a workflow whose literal recipient cannot access the workspace fails, and the runner will not send to one.

sourceHandle.description: Use then or else for if_else source branches.

entryNodeId.description: Workflow entry point. Must reference the workflow trigger node, or be null without one.

definition.description: Persisted workflow definition with graph references validated.

path.description: Dot-path to a value in the workflow run context.

fallback.description: Fallback string used when the referenced path is missing.

left.description: Reference to dynamic workflow data used by conditions or actions.

right.description: Right-hand comparison value. Omit for presence operators.

path.description: Dot-path to a value in the workflow run context.

fallback.description: Fallback string used when the referenced path is missing.

name: duplicate_workflow
title: Duplicate workflow
description: Duplicate a Forma workflow as a new draft (empty run + version history) using the v3 Workflows API contract.

workflowId.description: Workflow ID to duplicate as a new draft.

name.description: Optional name for the copy. If omitted, the server picks a non-conflicting name.

name: delete_workflow
title: Delete workflow
description: Delete a Forma workflow using the v3 Workflows API contract.

name: enable_workflow
title: Enable workflow
description: Enable a Forma workflow using the v3 Workflows API contract: validate executability, snapshot an immutable version, and make it live. Once live it runs on matching survey responses and can send emails.

name: disable_workflow
title: Disable workflow
description: Disable a live Forma workflow (stops future runs) using the v3 Workflows API contract.

name: archive_workflow
title: Archive workflow
description: Archive a Forma workflow using the v3 Workflows API contract.

name: unarchive_workflow
title: Unarchive workflow
description: Unarchive a Forma workflow (back to draft) using the v3 Workflows API contract.

name: list_workspaces
title: List workspaces
description: List the Forma workspaces the authenticated user can access. Use this to discover the workspaceId required by the survey and workflow tools.

name: list_responses
title: List responses
description: List the responses to a Forma survey, newest first, with each answer keyed by question id and shown with the question's headline. Answers to questions no longer in the survey, hidden fields and embedded data are under otherData. Unless includeContact is true, each response's contact, contact attributes, IP address and verified email are withheld; answers to questions that ask for contact details, such as a contact info or address question, are returned like any other answer. Requires the responses:read scope and read access to the survey's workspace.

surveyId.description: Survey ID whose responses should be listed.

limit.description: Maximum number of responses to return. Defaults to 20.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous list_responses response.

finished.description: Only finished responses (true) or only partial ones (false). Omit for both.

createdFrom.description: Only responses created at or after this ISO 8601 date-time, with a time zone, for example 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z.

createdTo.description: Only responses created at or before this ISO 8601 date-time, with a time zone, for example 2026-01-31T23:59:59Z.

search.description: Only responses whose free-text answers contain this keyword, case-insensitively.

includeContact.description: Also return who answered: each response's contact (id and userId) when it has one, the contact attributes captured with it, its IP address when the survey captured one, and, on a survey that requires email verification, the verified email address under otherData.verifiedEmail. Defaults to false; leave it off unless the user needs to identify respondents.

name: get_survey_summary
title: Get survey summary
description: Summarize the responses to a Forma survey as its summary page does: impressions, starts, completions and drop-off, then per question the response count and its statistics (choice counts and percentages, rating averages, NPS score, CSAT, matrix and ranking results) and the most recent open-text answers, plus quotas and the total score when the survey has them. No contact, contact attributes, IP address or verified email is returned; the listed answers to questions that ask for contact details, such as a contact info or address question, are returned like any other answer. Requires the responses:read scope and read access to the survey's workspace.

finished.description: Only finished responses (true) or only partial ones (false). Omit for both.

createdFrom.description: Only responses created at or after this ISO 8601 date-time, with a time zone, for example 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z.

createdTo.description: Only responses created at or before this ISO 8601 date-time, with a time zone, for example 2026-01-31T23:59:59Z.

search.description: Only responses whose free-text answers contain this keyword, case-insensitively.

samplesPerQuestion.description: How many individual answers to keep for questions that list them (open text, Other options, hidden fields, file uploads), newest first, and how many of the most frequent values to keep in the value breakdowns of hidden fields and Other options, the rest counted together. Counts always cover every matching response. Defaults to 10.
